title: fix(plugin-grid): phone card amount slot takes a formula or summary that draws as money

## 维护者速读
- 手机上看订单行、报价行这类明细列表时，卡片右下角的金额现在显示这一行的总额，不再错显示单价；电脑上的表格不变。
- 属于手机端列表卡片的体验线，替 HotCRM 等有明细行的应用解决金额读错的问题。
- 只改卡片挑哪一列当金额，数据和接口都不变；若挑错，最多是卡片上金额位置显示另一列，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `buildMobileCardRenderer`: the amount slot now takes the first shown body column whose value draws as money. That is a `currency` column, or a `formula` / `summary` column for which `resolveFormulaValueType(fieldDef, number)` (the exported `@object-ui/fields` rule the formula cell draws by) answers `currency`: a formula declaring `returnType: 'currency'`, or a summary declaring its currency (`currencyConfig`). The slot is still chosen once for the list, so every card keeps one shape.
- Unchanged: a masked column is not promoted; a view that presents the field as another type (column `type`) keeps it a plain value; a number-returning formula is not an amount; view order still picks among several money columns; desktop table untouched.
- No new export (seat ruling: option A). `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`.

## Why
On a phone, an order line (2 × 6,000.00, 10% off) showed its unit price 6,000.00 in the amount slot; the line total 10,800.00 is a formula returning currency, which the slot never considered. Reordering columns did not help: the total moved into the subtitle.

## Tests
`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx`, a new top-level `describe` in the existing harness (390 px):
- currency formula shown before the unit price → amount `CN¥10,800.00`, subtitle `2 · CN¥6,000.00`;
- currency formula as the only money column → amount `CN¥10,800.00`;
- summary declaring its currency → amount `CN¥777.00`;
- unit price shown first stays the amount (view order unchanged);
- CONTROL: number-returning formula → no amount line;
- CONTROL: the currency formula presented as `type: 'text'` → no amount line.

- New describe at b4dd4f20: `Tests  11 passed (11)` for the harness file.

- After merging origin/main (which brought #37929, also in plugin-grid) and rebuilding the closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'`, 57/57): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/`: `Test Files  319 passed (319)`, `Tests  2805 passed (2805)`.
- eslint on the two changed files: 0 errors (155 warnings, none on the changed hunk).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at b4dd4f20: 39 derived, 39 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Premise measured on origin/main 815e882b before writing (390 px probe, readings on the card's pre-claim report): unit price first → slot `CN¥6,000.00`; total first → slot still `CN¥6,000.00`, total in subtitle; formula-only or summary-only → no slot, though the cell already drew currency.
- `#37929` and `#37924` also touch `ObjectGrid.tsx`, in hunks far from this one; whichever lands later merges main.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `ObjectGrid.tsx`: `drawsAsMoney` and the `amountCol` line under it.
2. The new `describe` in `phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx`, especially the two CONTROL cases.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx` shows 11 passing; replace `drawsAsMoney(c)` with `c.type === 'currency'` and the same command shows 3 failing.
